scope: Independent reading of all ten rows and all twenty stored KWICs for exact headword evidence, speaker and deployment, lexical boundary, distinct-work support, printed-form normalization, and disposition under the Iriya and dictionary-entry guides.

cohortFindings.exactEvidence: PASS — every stored KWIC contains the exact corpus query. The only non-exact printed headword is separately identified and resolved rather than represented as verbatim corpus text.
cohortFindings.deployment: PASS — each admitted headword has an observable job in an address, interview answer, raised case, warning, or critic's verdict; none is admitted from frequency alone.
cohortFindings.units: PASS — nine single components remain intact. 能爲萬象主、不逐四時凋 correctly remains the sole couplet because both propositions are raised together and organize the tests in both works.
cohortFindings.workIndependence: PASS — every row cites two different workIds and the paired witnesses provide materially usable deployments rather than split volumes of one work.
cohortFindings.variantHandling: PASS — the printed couplet's 爲→為 and 、→， resolution is explicit, and evidence consistently uses the resolved exact corpus query.
cohortFindings.dispositions: PASS — all ten KEEP decisions are supported by the cited full cases.

reviews.finding: Baoyen makes the phrase his express verdict on the Buddha's beginning-to-end handling before stating its limitation; the independent address promises the same complete handling to responsive investigators. Component boundary and multi-work support pass.

The Blue Cliff commentary excludes even iron eyes from getting hold of Xuedou's line, while Yuanwu independently gives the exact phrase as a direct answer and tests the monk's extension. This is a recurrent case verdict, not ordinary failed searching.

The first address fixes the institutional scene in which dependent interpretation is prohibited; the independent interview incorporates that exact scene into the direct answer 七尺單前豎脊梁. The admission rests on this Chan institutional deployment, not on the measurement alone.

A monk raises the phrase as the premise of a demand for the master's answer; Yuanwu separately says that even this position still requires raising the eye higher. The exact component is tested rather than merely narrated.

One address judges reflected-moon and echoed-sound understanding still to be an affair at this shore; Tianyin independently makes the shore the stated situation in which karmic awareness does or does not drag a person. The recurring test-point exceeds literal geography.

Fushan gives the weather phrase directly as the upward road. A separate record raises the same old answer to the year-end question and makes its repetition the object of a blow. Exact component, deployment, and work independence pass.

Case critics explicitly dispute whether Kasyapa acted according to the command; Lia'an independently applies the same criterion to the moon-viewing case and states the disciplinary consequence. It is a recurrent case standard, not generic obedience prose.

reviews.term: 能爲萬象主、不逐四時凋
reviews.finding: The author correctly distinguishes the exact-absent printed 爲/、 form from the corpus-exact 為/， form. Both independent interviews raise the whole two-proposition verse and test the lord-of-myriad-forms clause in relation to the non-withering clause; KEEP (couplet) is the correct unit.

One lineage case records the phrase at the bodily-total breakthrough that drives the student to seize and question his teacher; the independent interview gives it as the direct answer concerning the Linji transmission. This recurring total-penetration formula is not anatomical narration.

A critic prescribes the proper fodder as the fitting response to the student; Yuanwu independently calls even that proper fodder an extra branch when asking for a phrase outside the teaching gate. The feeding image performs an evaluative and corrective Chan job.
